title: Employment Standards Act
verified_how: Fetched the register's A-Z index (https://www.justice.gov.nt.ca/en/legislation/), which lists 'Employment Standards Act' with a consolidation (Modified) date of September 21, 2026, then fetched the consolidation itself. Its cover page prints the citation the register uses - 'EMPLOYMENT STANDARDS ACT / SNWT 2007,c.13 / In force April 1, 2008; SI-002-2008' (French: 'LOI SUR LES NORMES D'EMPLOI / LTNO 2007, ch. 13') - followed by the amendment chain down to SNWT 2023,c.7[E]. Not marked repealed. Currency statement, from the register's disclaimer: 'These consolidations are updated monthly and may not be the most current version available', and this consolidation is 'not an official statement of the law... an office consolidation prepared by Legislation Division, Department of Justice, for convenience only.'
notes: Wage payment, minimum wage, hours and overtime. Federally regulated employers in the NWT (banking, interprovincial transport, telecommunications) are under the Canada Labour Code, R.S.C. 1985, c. L-2 instead. The register separately lists a Payroll Tax Act, but that is a tax on remuneration, not a wage-payment statute; it is noted under Personal tax/withholding.
